stick to basics
Jul 2016 • Friends
Long been known to expats as one of the best place for an English breakfast, it didn't disappoint.

The furniture and staff are not the most classy in town but I was not going to judge until I tasted the food. My friend and I ordered an English breakfast, chicken burger , a portion of french fries and a coleslaw. Drinks wise we had English breakfast tea and a strawberry smoothie. Beers (Sapporo, Heineken, Tiger),were available for around 25k VND upwards.
.

Food came in reasonable time. Chicken burger was good. Not the best I have had but nothing to complain about. Breast fillet was well cooked and not dry. English breakfast wise the hash browns were very good, tomatoes and mushrooms were cooked well and fresh. Beans were warm. I ordered extra baked beans as they rarely give out enough out here. Bacon was also good not too much oil left around the plate. The sausage really was the star of the show. That alone was worth the visit. Two fried eggs were nicely done and the fries were fine too. The English tea was with a Twinnings tea bag so they do try.

We checked out 340k VND for two so again cannot complain about the price. Well deserved 4 stars.

The place is in the end of a small alley 50m in so taxis may not be able to get in. Not easiest place to find. No doubt there are things to work on but quite happy to visit again in the future. Many folks like to come for the burgers so will give that a try next time.

Service is sub-par
May 2016 • Solo
Strangely enough, places serving a good hearty Western breakfast do not abound in town. So I was very eager to experiment this new place Con Bo Map (that in Vietnamese means Mad Cow if I am not mistaken). 

The food is ok, but the portions are quite small (so do not get duped by the seemingly good prices, it is less for less). What pissed me off was waiting half an hour with the place half empty for a banal English breakfast. I am leaving this as constructive feedback.

They also have a location in district 7 that I visited too and suffered from the same lack of efficient service.

ConBoMap
Dear Katanankes,

Many thanks for taking the time to leave a review for us.

'Con Bo Map' actually translates to 'The Fat Cow'. With regards to our portions, we do operate on a strict 'what you see is what you get' policy with our food pictures, and we do endeavour to put those pictures on our walls and in our new menus to ensure customers know exactly what they'll be getting, in the case of our full english breakfast that means 2 eggs, 4 slices of bacon, a sausage, mushrooms, a whole (halved) tomato, 2 hash browns, 2 slices of toast and butter, plus a tea or coffee. I'm not sure what you received in your order, but that is what we deliver for that, so there isn't really a question of portion size.
Our service is based around the idea that our staff stay out of the customers way as much as possible once the order has been taken and the food served. We just want our customers to enjoy their meal in peace without having staff hovering at their shoulder. However, this should not lead to bad or inattentive service. In busy periods customers may have to wait slightly longer than usual, as all of our food is cooked fresh to order.
With regards to the breakfast being 'banal', I'm not sure what you were expecting, its a simple fried breakfast, just as advertised. Perhaps its just not for you.

Best Regards

Con Bo Map
